title: Prompt Router / Meta-Orchestrator execution layer derived from 32→64 cycles

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directives: develop/execute 32 prompts, analyze, persist, derive 64; system-wide not book/audio-only

problem_or_opportunity: IVDIVO has strong authorities, prompts and domain engines, but material execution still requires repeated state normalization, manual task packaging, repeated guard prose and fragmented evidence/write-through. Good prompts alone do not create a durable self-improving factory.
proposed_mechanism: Extend Self-Improvement v2/current machine execution with CURRENT Surface Manifest -> heterogeneous State Adapter -> Shared Fact Contracts -> Obligation DAG -> Prompt IR -> pre-tool guards -> execution -> post-tool readback -> transactional persistence -> unified telemetry/evidence -> learning -> rebase -> next route. Keep books P1 and book-to-audio P2 while applying the same improvement architecture to multi-AI, code, research, economics and operations.
expected_benefit: Reduce manual routing/context duplication and stale writes; make system learning evidence-based and durable while preventing recursive meta-work from starving real book/audio production.

external_blockers: fresh Founder idea for live Idea→Story calibration
